title: Controller income is capped at full calls minus one: even-part rank bound in the p16 Laurent alphabet (scoped negative result; no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped negative result; no new κ, no supplier change. Adds `research/p104-controller-income-bound`: in the literal Laurent caller alphabet of the retained p16 controllers (`research/p104-productive-controller/caller.py`), no caller word can twist more outputs than it has paid odd shears, minus one (even-part rank argument: free events preserve the rank of the even parts, a paid shear changes one row so the rank drops by at most one, and the first paid shear leaves it unchanged). Consequence: the controller's rank-mass income per port is at most the number of full calls minus one, and the three retained controllers attain it (32 twisted outputs from 33 shears; income 17 = 18 − 1). Hence the first-order mass surplus obeys M ≤ calls × (ports − centre) − ports (PR5907 word: 18 × 48 − 104 = 760). Status: proof (PROOF.md) plus an exact replay of the three literal controllers over ℚ. Remaining obligations: none inside the alphabet; a multi-bank or cross-port paid primitive is outside it.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`. Inputs (pinned in SOURCES.json): `research/kappa-backward-controller-20261023/CONTROLLER.json`, `research/joint-helper-lattice/CONTROLLER.json`, `research/p104-productive-controller/CONTROLLER.json` and `caller.py`. Task card `joint-query-controller` (scope refined: the card asks for a controller that beats the retained one; this package proves the mass side cannot be beaten with the same number of full calls, see TASK.json).

Nearest overlap: Cinna Davis's `research/productive-controller-basis-search` (GLOBAL-PROOF.md, Theorem B) proves `queries ≥ 2p + 1` for `2p` independent monomial outputs over F₂[Q]/(Q² − 1), constant binary boundaries, no idle work, and states that the binary theorem is not asserted for complex words; its PROOF.md uses the even-part rank change as a search pruning rule. This package is the complex-side counterpart: the same count in the rational Laurent alphabet with idle markers, output by output, stated as a bound on the complete invoice's income, checked on the literal controllers; it answers that package's first open question for the rank mass (queries beyond 2p + 1 cannot raise the income). `research/p104-thin-query-port-floor` (#5996) is a different statement (15 thin requests are necessary with the 18 LOCALs fixed); PR5554 covers the moment side for path controllers.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-controller-income-bound/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-controller-income-bound
```

Standard library only, 0.3 s. Evidence: even-rank trace 32, 32, 31, …, 0 over the 33 paid shears for θ = Q² ∈ {7/3, 11/5} on all three controllers, all 32 declared diagonal outputs odd monomials, income 17 recomputed from the literal word. Controls: the two-bank Whitehead word with three odd shears reaches diag(Q, Q⁻¹) with trace 2, 2, 1, 0 and its two-shear prefix leaves an even part; dropping the last QUERY_SHEAR of the p104 controller leaves a positive even rank and its declared diagonal is rejected; a free Q^{±1} is rejected by the alphabet. RESULT.json compared in full. Finite checks support, and do not replace, the written lemma. Not run: no selected-result replay, no outer ledger (nothing changes).

## Credit

Controllers by Cinna Davis (p16/a7 lattice), Ali Romman (PR5398 wrapper, PR5544 all-forward caller) and the P104 lineage; Cinna Davis's `productive-controller-basis-search` for the binary 2p + 1 theorem and the even-part pruning idea; zxv (PR5405/PR5554) for the path-family ceilings; `fragmentation-ceiling` for the moment side. Prepared by Matarener with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code; substantial AI assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Does the bound extend to paid primitives that are not odd central shears of one pair (a paid rank-r Gaussian touching several banks or ports)? Such a primitive is the only way to raise the controller income above full calls minus one. First step: state it as a physical job in `caller.py` terms and extend the tracker. Blocked by: a new physical primitive.
2. Is the bound attained with more full calls, and does the resulting invoice ever beat p = 16? Income grows by (ports − centre) per call but target ranks and idle chunks grow too (PR5907 word: p = 20 gives 0.003117). Blocked by: a non-path caller word.
